title: A Verdict for the Parish Revisited
author: Elodie Halloran
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
